name: World Food Programme (WFP)
note: UN humanitarian agency; its logo has been on the club's shirt since 31 May 2025 as a charity partnership: the club gives up the revenue of the upper-centre chest slot and has pledged an additional donation (K League, 2025-05-28). A UN body, so there is no owner record; left unrated for a maintainer, since `none` needs a sourced ownership claim.
